scope: JSDOM with production route UI, simulation, recorder and exact playback. Explicit host scene-switch adapter. No browser graphics, native keyboard/gamepad, audible device or GPU acceptance.

checks.name: Two complete real trajectories produce a matched time/energy/gas difference
Practice switch requires fresh preparation and restores full battery
External recorder stop cannot become route success or overwrite its result
Changing recorder owner preserves the unrelated active recording
Review protects live car; changed parameters require preparation
Small paused yaw or velocity edits invalidate exact prepared start
Lab-to-city preparation configures the target sim and preserves original lab state
Language switch preserves mode; persisted history retains all recent results
Rejected storage preserves in-memory result; actual summary encoder exports exact retained runs
